metadata.description: Environment slug used in resource names. Lowercase letters and digits only.
Azure region for every resource.
Image tag for mf-api. The CI pipeline bumps this on every revision.
Image tag for the segment job.
Image tag for the render job.
GPU workload-profile SKU for the segment job. Default NC8as-T4 (~$1.20/hr). Requires GPU quota.
Enable the GPU workload profile + segment job. Set false on subscriptions without GPU quota; the API + render pipeline still deploys.
CPU workload-profile SKU name. Default D4 (4 vCPU / 16 GiB).

Enable Azure OpenAI account + deployment. Requires Cognitive Services access (often gated on personal subs). When false, the API falls back to MOTION_FORGE_LLM_BACKEND env (anthropic, openai, ollama, mock).
Enable Cosmos DB serverless. When false the API runs without a project index — useful to skip past a failed Cosmos provisioning while you sort it out separately.
Mount the Azure Files NFS share into the API + segment containers. Requires the Container Apps Environment to be on a custom VNet (BYOVNet). Off by default since BYOVNet is a heavier setup.
Log Analytics retention in days. SOC 2 CC4 requires 90 days minimum; bump to 180 for production.
CORS allowed origins for the API container. Default locks to localhost + motion.ursly.io; set to [] to disable CORS entirely. Avoid ['*'] in production (SOC 2 CC6).
Azure OpenAI model deployment name (e.g., gpt-5, gpt-4o, phi-4).
OpenAI model name as published in Azure OpenAI service catalog.
OpenAI model version. Empty string uses the deployment default.
Front Door SKU. Standard_AzureFrontDoor is sufficient for dev; Premium for prod (adds WAF + private link origins).
Min replicas for the API. Keep at 1 for the no-cold-start guarantee.
Max replicas for the API.
Tags applied to every resource.

properties.workloadProfiles: [if(parameters('enableGpuProfile'), createArray(createObject('name', 'Consumption', 'workloadProfileType', 'Consumption'), createObject('name', parameters('cpuProfileName'), 'workloadProfileType', 'D4', 'minimumCount', 0, 'maximumCount', 3), createObject('name', 'gpu-t4', 'workloadProfileType', parameters('gpuProfileType'), 'minimumCount', 0, 'maximumCount', 2)), createArray(createObject('name', 'Consumption', 'workloadProfileType', 'Consumption'), createObject('name', parameters('cpuProfileName'), 'workloadProfileType', 'D4', 'minimumCount', 0, 'maximumCount', 3)))]
